Messages.Author: Ethan Burrow
Messages.Body:
Couple of questions regarding how this card interacts with some others:

1) I just wanted to verify that the damage done by DOTB is aggravated if
Dawn Op was played as the action was blocked and combat resulted. And
let's say the opponent played a S:CE, would they still take Agg Damage
from the above combo?

2) If you Dawn Op, and then play Form of Mist to continue the action,
and it is still blocked (Another reacting minion plays the intercept),
is the Dawn Op still "in play" for this second combat, or does it only
last for the first combat?

Thanks.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
On Sun, 19 Dec 1999, Ethan Burrow wrote:

> 1) I just wanted to verify that the damage done by DOTB is aggravated if
> Dawn Op was played as the action was blocked and combat resulted. And
> let's say the opponent played a S:CE, would they still take Agg Damage
> from the above combo?

The damage from DotB occurs at the end of the combat, but still within it.
So yes, it can benefit from a Dawn Op.

>
> 2) If you Dawn Op, and then play Form of Mist to continue the action,
> and it is still blocked (Another reacting minion plays the intercept),
> is the Dawn Op still "in play" for this second combat, or does it only
> last for the first combat?

Actin modifiers are still in effect e.g. stealth. The ruling is:

Form of Mist - Combat (pro)
If the superior form is used to continue an action, then all action
modifiers, including stealth and Dawn Operation, are still in effect. [RTR
19941109]

So yes, the Dawn Op still works.

--

James Coupe
